test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark ( ? ) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/742fcc6a885c805c2d9c7966f958432beb1e447366ebfe6775c7ec89787424d5.png]
solution:
The logic here followed is :

1) Two different series are followed below. The letter placed in the left upper corner is increased by +1 and the letter placed in the right lower corner is increased by +3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f926596edad0fdae165acc46a3c2a45bff0b576fa96db63e3b19d0d37412b21.png] 

2) Two different series are followed below. The letter placed in the right upper corner is increased by +2 and the letter placed in the left lower corner is increased by +4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e47cbe750f28a57f0504bdb2630b42ccbb9a58c57799fee5776ad43a343a333.png] 

 

Hence, the correct answer is** "option 2".**
